name: Gapped-core inductor
summary: A gapped-core inductor includes a documented air gap in its magnetic circuit.
description: A gapped-core inductor includes a documented air gap in its magnetic circuit. The drawing identifies that construction while the component data establishes inductance and operating limits.
readingNotes: A core gap marker describes the magnetic circuit, not an electrical disconnect.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A magnetic air gap is different from an open power-circuit connection.
